PublicPageShowRequest.description:
Query-string params for PublicPageController::show(). Extracted from the
controller (LAYER-02) so `?preview=1&preview_expires=...&preview_sig=...`
parsing/typing lives in the DTO layer instead of raw `$this->request->getGet()`
calls in the closure. Stays a pure data object — verifying the signature
against lang+slug (PreviewToken::verify()) is left to the controller,
which is the same class of HTTP-boundary security check the base
ApiController itself performs for JWTs, not domain business logic.

items.description: Rows to reorder. IDs must be unique and belong to the requested scope.

scope.description: Optional resource scope. Entries require collection_id; menu_items require menu_id; block_instances require owner_type and owner_id.

TranslationAuditReportRequest.description:
Filters + pagination for TranslationAuditController::report(). Extracted
from the controller (LAYER-02) so query-string parsing/validation lives in
the DTO layer, matching this app's DTO-first convention, instead of the
controller reading `$this->request->getGet(...)` directly.
